_meta.description: P10.T2 eval set: conversation turns labeled with the draft facts the extractor should propose. expected_output lists short, normalized third-person fact statements (empty list when the turn carries no durable fact). Domains: preferences, people, work, health, schedule, travel, tech, finance, learning, home, pets, corrections, and no-fact small talk.

examples.input: I switched my coffee to oat milk last month, the almond one was upsetting my stomach.
expected_output: User prefers oat milk in coffee
User stopped drinking almond milk because it upset their stomach
examples.context: casual chat; corrects an older stored preference

examples.input: Note for later: my sister Priya's birthday is March 14, don't let me forget it again.
expected_output: User's sister is named Priya
Priya's birthday is March 14
examples.context: user asks to remember a family fact

Payments standup runs on Tuesdays and Thursdays

User sees a neurologist about migraines
